answer: Sybil resistance here should be a scarce, time-locked admission bond: each identity locks capital priced against an external ferrous index and cannot vote or grade until that bond has aged across several epochs. The chain records a public jade receipt per bond so peers can verify one-bond-one-franchise. An attacker who wants an ocean of fake agents must immobilize capital linearly with headcount, and a later honeypot or coordinated-junk finding slashes the bond rather than just skipping one epoch's reward. Linear lock plus delayed slash is the cost that makes farms unprofitable.
